notes: WHO Europe April 2023 photo story describes Greenland at the western edge of WHO European Region. Does not establish a 2026 country-area administrative assignment or constitutional WHO membership.
WHO Europe account says Greenland health minister and Regional Director agreed on expanded collaboration at 28 June 2023 visit. This is dialogue not a binding clinical recommendation.

WHO press notice reports a signed five-year Greenland-WHO Europe memorandum covering ten priority areas. Actual agreement instrument and precise end day or renewal not reviewed; not WHO membership or national protocol adoption.

The WHO MoU notice mentions potential participation in technical activities of the Small Countries Initiative and Regions for Health Network. It does not confirm formal SCI membership or completed local implementation.
